description: Structured eval definitions for the FSx Filesystem Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across FSx topologies (FSx for Windows Multi-AZ with AD and dedup, FSx for Lustre PERSISTENT with S3 export and compression, FSx for ONTAP Multi-AZ with SVM and tiering, Single-AZ Windows with throughput stepping, missing AD prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: FSx for Windows Multi-AZ with AD integration and dedup
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Windows Multi-AZ, AD joined, dedup with estimated savings, shadow copies, DNS aliases, both subnets cited
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FSx for Windows file system in us-east-1. Multi-AZ deployment, 1024 GB SSD storage, 32 MB/s throughput capacity. Join to Managed AD directory d-aaa111222. VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnets subnet-aaa111 (us-east-1a) and subnet-bbb222 (us-east-1b). Enable dedup (GeneralPurpose). Enable shadow copies. DNS alias fileshare.example.com. KMS encryption with AWS-managed key. Backup: daily automatic, 7-day retention. Maintenance window: Tuesday 01:00. Tags: Environment=production, ManagedBy=cloudops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FSX_FILESYSTEM: fs-aaa111222 (WINDOWS, MULTI_AZ_1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] File system type: Windows
  [✓] Storage type: SSD
  [✓] Storage capacity: 1024 GB
  [✓] Deployment type: Multi-AZ
  [✓] Throughput capacity: 32 MB/s
  [✓] VPC: vpc-aaa11122
  [✓] Subnet AZ1: subnet-aaa111 (us-east-1a)
  [✓] Subnet AZ2: subnet-bbb222 (us-east-1b)
  [✓] AD integration: d-aaa111222 — joined
  [✓] DNS aliases: fileshare.example.com
  [✓] Dedup: enabled (GeneralPurpose, est. savings 50-80%)
  [✓] Shadow copies: enabled
  [✓] KMS encryption: AWS-managed
  [✓] Backup: automatic (daily, retention 7 days)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fsx describe-file-systems --file-system-ids fs-aaa111222 --region us-east-1
  aws fsx describe-backups --filters Name=file-system-id,Values=fs-aaa111222 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: FSx for Lustre PERSISTENT with S3 export and compression
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Lustre PERSISTENT_1, S3 data repository linked (import/export), LZ4 compression, auto-import policy configured
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FSx for Lustre file system in us-east-1. PERSISTENT_1 deployment, 2400 GB SSD storage, 1000 MB/s/TB throughput. S3 export from s3://my-hpc-bucket/data with auto-import policy NEW_CHANGED. LZ4 compression. VPC vpc-ccc33344, subnet subnet-ccc333 (us-east-1a). Tags: Environment=production, Workload=hpc.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FSX_FILESYSTEM: fs-ccc333444 (LUSTRE, PERSISTENT_1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] File system type: Lustre
  [✓] Deployment type: PERSISTENT_1
  [✓] Storage type: SSD
  [✓] Storage capacity: 2400 GB
  [✓] Throughput capacity: 1000 MB/s/TB
  [✓] VPC: vpc-ccc33344
  [✓] Subnet AZ1: subnet-ccc333 (us-east-1a)
  [✓] S3 export: s3://my-hpc-bucket/data (import/export, auto-import NEW_CHANGED)
  [✓] Data compression: LZ4
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fsx describe-file-systems --file-system-ids fs-ccc333444 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: FSx for ONTAP Multi-AZ with SVM and volume tiering
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — ONTAP Multi-AZ, SVM created, volume with auto-tiering and storage efficiency enabled
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FSx for ONTAP file system in us-east-1. Multi-AZ deployment, 1024 GB storage. VPC vpc-eee55566, subnets subnet-eee555 (us-east-1a) and subnet-fff666 (us-east-1b). Create SVM svm-prod and volume vol-prod (1 TB) with auto tiering policy and storage efficiency enabled. Tags: Environment=production, ManagedBy=cloudops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FSX_FILESYSTEM: fs-eee555666 (ONTAP, MULTI_AZ_1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] File system type: ONTAP
  [✓] Deployment type: Multi-AZ
  [✓] Storage capacity: 1024 GB
  [✓] VPC: vpc-eee55566
  [✓] Subnet AZ1: subnet-eee555 (us-east-1a)
  [✓] Subnet AZ2: subnet-fff666 (us-east-1b)
  [✓] ONTAP tiering: auto (storage efficiency enabled)
  [✓] SVM: svm-prod
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fsx describe-file-systems --file-system-ids fs-eee555666 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: FSx for Windows Single-AZ with throughput capacity stepping
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Windows Single-AZ, throughput stepped to 256 MB/s (nearest step above 180 MB/s with headroom), HDD storage
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FSx for Windows file system in us-east-1. Single-AZ deployment, 512 GB HDD storage. Join to Managed AD directory d-aaa111222. VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnet subnet-aaa111 (us-east-1a). The workload needs approximately 180 MB/s throughput. Tags: Environment=dev, ManagedBy=cloudops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FSX_FILESYSTEM: fs-xxx (WINDOWS, SINGLE_AZ_1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] File system type: Windows
  [✓] Storage type: HDD
  [✓] Storage capacity: 512 GB
  [✓] Deployment type: Single-AZ
  [✓] Throughput capacity: 256 MB/s (stepped above 180 MB/s requirement)
  [✓] AD integration: d-aaa111222 — joined
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fsx describe-file-systems --file-system-ids fs-xxx --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: FSx for Windows without Active Directory (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no Active Directory available; FSx for Windows requires AD integration
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FSx for Windows file system in us-east-1. Multi-AZ deployment, 1024 GB SSD. VPC vpc-noad, subnets subnet-ggg777 (us-east-1a) and subnet-hhh888 (us-east-1b). There is no Active Directory configured in this account.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FSX_FILESYSTEM: fs-xxx (WINDOWS, MULTI_AZ_1)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] AD integration: no Active Directory available — FSx for Windows requires AD for authentication
